title: Ndị Mebichara Ọgbụgba Ndụ A chụpụrụ n'Agha
intro: N'oge mbụ nke obodo ọhụrụ, otu ebo bi n'ụlọ ndị e wusiri ike, ndị e ji nkwekọrịta kee. Mgbe e mere ka nkwekọrịta ahụ dịgide, ihe si na ya pụta na-apụta ìhè n'ime peeji nke Quran. Olee ndị bụ ndị a, gịnịkwa mere ụlọ na ubi mkpụrụ osisi ha?
clues: Anyị bi n'ebe siri ike nke mere ka anyị nwee mmetụta nke ịnọ ná nchebe na-ezighị ezi.
Anyị bụ ndị Akwụkwọ Nsọ, mana anyị mebiri ọgbụgba ndụ anyị.
Anyị kparịtara nkata megide onye ozi ahụ mgbe ọ bịakwutere anyị, mana atụmatụ anyị dara ada.
E gbuturu osisi nkwụ anyị site n'iwu Chineke, ihe ịrịba ama nke ike Ya.
A chụpụrụ anyị n'ụlọ anyị, anyị agaghị alaghachi azụ, dị ka ntaramahụhụ maka nnupụisi anyị.
Koran kwuru maka anyị n'isiakwụkwọ nke nzukọ ahụ, akụkọ anyị na-abụkwa ịdọ aka ná ntị nye ndị mebiri nkwekọrịta.

trial.answer: Mgbagbu na ịchụpụ ha n'ụlọ ha

outcome.label: Nsonaazụ
options: A chụpụrụ ha ma nara ihe onwunwe ha
A gbaghaara ha ma nọgide na-anọgide
A tara ha ahụhụ site n'ọrịa
outcome.answer: A chụpụrụ ha ma nara ihe onwunwe ha

arabic: مَا قَطَعْتُم مِّن لِّينَةٍ أَوْ تَرَكْتُمُوهَا قَآئِمَةً عَلَىٰٓ أُصُولِهَا فَبِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ وَلِيُخْزِىَ ٱلْفَـٰسِقِينَ
verse: Whatever you have cut down of [their] palm trees or left standing on their trunks - it was by permission of Allāh and so He would disgrace the defiantly disobedient. (59:5)
